comment: Two things in the source do not match the README. The default scale, used when the scale jack is unpatched, repeats after eleven semitones rather than twelve (Harp.cpp:103 sets scaleSize to 11 with the comment "default to chromatic"), so the unpatched module is not chromatic. And the note-range parameter is configured with a minimum of 2, a maximum of 16 and a default of 48 (Harp.cpp:60), which looks like the arguments transposed; the menu offers 2 to 48 and writes the parameter directly rather than through its quantity, so the larger values do work, but a new module starts at 48. All four parameters have no widget on the panel and are set from the menu, so none is tagged.
